correctness.rationale: PASS: In the normalized symmetric square of C^n, one-body Fourier energies are 2J cos((Phi-2pi k)/n). At fixed total momentum p the unordered boson pair energies are nondegenerate unless cos((Phi-pi p)/n)=0; no nonresonant cancellation of the diagonal Fourier mode is possible. At the sole resonant p, all free pair energies are zero, the collision map has rank one, and subtracting |d_p><d_p| from the symmetric total-momentum projector gives the entire dark projector. Positive rates ensure every other dissipative eigenvalue has negative imaginary part and its Jordan contribution decays. Fixed-point count of k->p-k gives the odd/even flux rank table; exchange translation gives the antipodal localized survival correction. Independent Hermitian two-boson matrix diagonalizations for 3<=n<=8 at Phi=0,pi/2,pi,3pi/2,pi/3 reproduced every rank. These 30 tests corroborate, not prove, the universal result. No sitewise rate equality or weak-loss assumption is needed.
